title: How Fast Do Agents Rot? An Empirical Study of Long-Horizon Degradation in LLM Agents for Production Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2609.01660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Production deployments of large language model (LLM) agents remain unreliable on long, multi-step workflows even as benchmark success rates climb steadily. We argue this gap is largely an artifact of task horizon: benchmarks are dominated by short-to-medium horizons where success remains high, while production workloads demand an order of magnitude more dependent steps. We measure the effect directly, characterizing the shape of agent degradation and disentangling its cause across a large controlled study spanning nine models, six open models from 1.2B to 671B parameters, and three deployed proprietary systems; four task families, including a genuinely agentic tool-use loop; five horizons; and three context regimes. Task success follows a geometric law governed by a single per-step reliability parameter, which rises with model scale but saturates well below 1 even for the strongest models, guaranteeing eventual collapse at sufficiently

translated_title: 智能体会以多快的速度“腐烂”？——面向生产决策的LLM智能体长时程性能退化的实证研究
translated_abstract: 尽管基准测试的成功率持续攀升，大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在生产环境部署中面对漫长的多步骤工作流时依然不可靠。我们认为这一差距在很大程度上是任务时程造成的假象：现有基准以短至中等时程的任务为主，在这些任务上成功率依然很高，而生产环境的工作负载所需的依赖步骤数量要多出一个数量级。我们直接测量了这一效应，通过一项大规模受控研究刻画了智能体退化的形态并厘清其成因——该研究涵盖九个模型（包括参数量从1.2B到671B的六个开源模型和三个已部署的专有系统）、四个任务族（包括一个真正具备智能体特性的工具使用循环）、五种时程长度以及三种上下文设置。研究发现，任务成功率遵循由单一的单步可靠性参数所支配的几何衰减规律，该参数随模型规模增大而上升，但即使在最强的模型中也远低于1，从而注定了在足够长的时程下智能体性能终将崩溃。
tldr: 该研究通过覆盖九个模型、四个任务族、五种时程和三种上下文设置的大规模受控实验，发现LLM智能体的任务成功率服从由单一“单步可靠性”参数决定的几何衰减规律，该参数虽随模型规模提升但始终远低于1，因此长时程任务中的性能崩溃不可避免。
en_tdlr: Through a large controlled study spanning nine models, four task families, five horizons, and three context regimes, this work shows that LLM agent task success follows a geometric law governed by a single per-step reliability parameter, which rises with model scale but saturates well below 1, making eventual collapse on long-horizon tasks inevitable.
